craft_claim: Warmth saturates: continuous direct address or affirmation with no new substance loses affiliative force and curdles into smarm, so the voice must yield at stakes peaks and at direct address of suffering.

supporting_evidence.location: The Managed Heart, surface acting and estrangement
supporting_evidence.note: Sustained managed friendliness produces surface acting and estrangement, and recipients detect forced affect, supporting the claim that continuous performed warmth degrades.
Sincerity is one of five brand-personality dimensions (down-to-earth, honest, wholesome, cheerful); as a perceived trait it must be earned by content rather than asserted by tone alone.
Positive-politeness forms presuppose a plausible common ground; when repeated without new relational information they become conventional and lose their redressive force.

counterevidence.note: Parasocial relationships can be sustained long term and take on aspects of friendship, so duration alone is not the problem; the saturation boundary is substance, not length.

scope: Long-form and serial content; openings, transition and closing frames.
exceptions: Deliberate persona comedy that makes the over-familiarity the joke.
